description: Compare nutrients side-by-side for 2–5 foods. Returns a structured table — one row per nutrient, one column per food — formatted as markdown. Best for "spinach vs kale iron" or "which has more protein?" questions. Accepts up to 500 FDC IDs: repeats are dropped, the first 5 distinct IDs are compared, and the rest are returned in deferredIds without being requested from FDC, with a notice naming the follow-up call. Omit nutrients[] to use the 12 most common defaults (energy, protein, fat, saturated fat, carbs, fiber, sugars, sodium, potassium, calcium, iron, vitamin C); a food that lacks the default energy (1008) or total sugars (2000) value has that cell filled from its equivalent nutrient — energy from 2048, then 2047; sugars from 1063 — and each fill is listed in substitutions. Provide nutrients[] with specific FDC IDs to compare different nutrients; an explicit list is compared as given, repeats dropped, without fills. All values are scaled to the same basis, quantity in unit: default 100 g, so unit="oz" alone compares per 100 oz and quantity alone is grams. A Branded food FDC reports per 100 ml (basisUnit "ml") or per 100 of a label unit that fixes neither (basisUnit absent) is compared on that basis without conversion, and a notice names it. If one or more FDC IDs are not found, the comparison proceeds with the valid foods — only throws too_few_foods when fdcIds holds fewer than 2 distinct IDs or fewer than 2 of the compared IDs return data. IDs FDC does not return before the call's deadline (slow Foundation records, most often) or keeps failing on are left out, listed in deferredIds ahead of any past the first 5, and named in a notice; when that leaves fewer than 2 foods, the call fails with retry_deadline_exceeded instead, or with too_few_foods when even answers for those IDs could not make 2 foods.

fdcIds.description: FDC IDs to compare — 2 to 500 entries (a server configured with strict limits rejects more than 5). Repeats are dropped; the first 5 distinct IDs are compared and the rest are returned in deferredIds. Use usda_search_foods to discover IDs.

nutrients.description: Nutrient IDs to include in the comparison. Defaults to the 12 most common: energy (1008), protein (1003), total fat (1004), saturated fat (1258), carbohydrate (1005), fiber (1079), total sugars (2000), sodium (1093), potassium (1092), calcium (1087), iron (1089), vitamin C (1162). Under the defaults, a food missing energy or total sugars has that cell filled from its equivalent nutrient (listed in substitutions); IDs given here are compared as given, repeats dropped. Use usda_list_nutrients to look up other IDs.

quantity.description: Amount of food, in unit, that every value is scaled to. Must be positive. Default 100.

unit.description: Unit for quantity. Default "g". Does not support "serving" (each food's portion weight differs, so a serving basis would not compare equal amounts).

name: usda_compare_foods

basis.description: The common scaling basis applied to all nutrient values.

gramWeight.description: Gram weight resolved from quantity and unit — every column is per this many grams, except that a food with basisUnit "ml" is per this many millilitres and one with no basisUnit per this many label units, compared without conversion.

quantity.description: Quantity applied, in unit — the requested value or the default 100.

unit.description: Unit applied (g, oz, lb, or kg) — the requested value or the default "g".

deferredIds.description: Distinct requested IDs this call did not compare, in request order: any of the first 5 FDC did not return before the call's deadline or kept failing on, then those past the first 5, which were never requested from FDC. The comparison leaves them out: they appear in neither foods nor missingData. Call usda_compare_foods with them and the same nutrients, quantity, and unit (pair a single one with an ID already compared), or fetch an unanswered one with usda_get_food. Absent when every distinct ID was requested and FDC answered each one.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `too_few_foods`: fdcIds holds fewer than 2 distinct IDs, or fewer than 2 of the compared IDs returned data, making comparison impossible. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: FDC did not answer within the call's 45-second budget, across every attempt. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

foods.description: The compared foods, in the same order as the values arrays below.

basisUnit.description: What the per-100 nutrient values are measured in: "g" for every non-Branded food and for Branded labels in g/GRM/GM, "ml" for Branded labels in ml/MLT. Absent when the label unit (e.g. IU, MG) fixes neither, so the basis is unverified.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

servingSizeUnit.description: Label serving unit as FDC reports it (e.g. "GRM", "MLT", "IU"); it sets basisUnit. Branded items only.

missingData.description: Foods or food+nutrient pairs where data was unavailable. A cell filled from an equivalent nutrient is listed in substitutions, not here. Absent when all data was present.

items.description: A food or food+nutrient pair where data was unavailable.

fdcId.description: FDC ID that had missing data.

nutrientId.description: Nutrient ID that was missing, or null when the entire food was not found.

notice.description: Present when deferredIds is, or a compared food is not reported per 100 g. First, how many distinct IDs past the first 5 were not requested, which of the first 5 FDC did not return before the deadline or kept failing on, and the call that fetches them; then the basis caveat naming each food not per 100 g: an ml food compared per basis.gramWeight millilitres, or a food whose per-100 basis is unverified, both without conversion.

nutrients.description: Nutrient rows — one entry per requested nutrient, with per-food values in the values[] array.

items.description: One nutrient row with per-food values.

values.description: One value per food in the same order as foods[]. null when data is unavailable for that food.

substitutions.description: Default-row cells filled from an equivalent nutrient because the food does not report the row ID, in nutrients[] then foods[] order. Absent when nothing was filled.

items.description: One default-row cell filled from an equivalent nutrient.

fdcId.description: FDC ID of the food whose cell was filled.

requested.description: Nutrient ID of the row: 1008 (energy) or 2000 (total sugars).

used.description: Nutrient ID the value was taken from: 2048 or 2047 for energy, 1063 for sugars.

title: Compare USDA Foods
